## v{{VERSION}} — {{SUMMARY}}

### Compatible with

- **HD3800** — tested on hardware

### Implemented

- Two independent cover entities per blind, one per rail, 0–100%
- Both rails moving together
- Collision guard, with a minimum 1% gap between the rails
- Read-back verification after every move
- Position persistence across restarts
- ESPHome Bluetooth proxy support

Not on an HD3800? It may still work. Only that motor has been verified, so if
yours differs, please try it and report what happens — that is what turns
"untested" into "supported".
